How did, this happen?
My mind is going, blank.
I can't remember.
Such as how to breathe, how to think properly, balancing the movement of my arms and legs, I have to think about it or I can't do them properly.

lines.japanese:
「あ……、は……」
　……何処に行こうというアテがあるワケでもない。
　ただ、理由もなく。
　無性に、金色の月が見たくなった。
lines.label: s289
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah… ha…”
…I have nowhere in mind. No destination, no reason. I simply find myself desperate to see the golden moon.
lines.mao_english:
“Ah… ha…”
…I have nowhere in mind. No destination, no reason. I simply find myself desperate to see the golden moon.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Ah……, ha……"
…… I don't have any place in mind.
Just, for no reason whatsoever.
I want to see golden moonlight.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Ah……, ha……"
…… I don't have any place in mind.
Just, for no reason whatsoever.
I want to see golden moonlight.

lines.japanese:
―――線が、消えない。
　視界の歪みが、一段とひどくなっている。
　夜の街は白い霧に覆われていて、もう何千年も前に死んでしまった都に似ている。
　街に人の気配はない。
　ビルというビル、建物という建物にかかる、蜘蛛の糸のような繭。
　ひどく、静か。
　深海の底に建てられたような死の都。
lines.label: s289
lines.maoEnglish:
—The lines won’t disappear. My vision is more distorted than ever. White mist shrouds the city at night, making it resemble a capital that died thousands of years ago.
There is no trace of anyone in the streets. Every building, every structure, lies cocooned in threads like a spider’s silk. Terribly quiet. A dead city built at the bottom of the abyssal sea.
lines.mao_english:
—The lines won’t disappear. My vision is more distorted than ever. White mist shrouds the city at night, making it resemble a capital that died thousands of years ago.
There is no trace of anyone in the streets. Every building, every structure, lies cocooned in threads like a spider’s silk. Terribly quiet. A dead city built at the bottom of the abyssal sea.
lines.mirrorMoon:
---The lines won't disappear.
The wavering in my vision worsens.
The night city is shrouded in a white fog, as if it was a city that died thousands of years ago.
There's no sign of anyone else.
A cocoon that's like a spider's web is everywhere on every building.
It's terribly quiet.
Like a dead city at the bottom of a vast ocean.
lines.mirror_moon:
---The lines won't disappear.

lines.japanese:
そんな幻視に眩わされながら、歩いた。
　頭上には一際大きく、晧晧と輝く黄金の月。
　月の光の恩恵だろうか。
　あれだけあった頭痛は消えて、頭の中は眠っている時みたいに、ぼんやりとしている。
　月の下。
　何かに惹かれるように、歩いていた。
lines.label: s289
lines.maoEnglish:
I walk, lost in that hallucination. Overhead hangs an enormous golden moon, pouring down immaculate light. Perhaps it is the moon’s grace: the headache has vanished, and my mind is dim and drifting, as though asleep.
Beneath the moon, I walk as though something is drawing me onward.
lines.mao_english:

Beneath the moon, I walk as though something is drawing me onward.
lines.mirrorMoon:
In that illusion, I still walk.
Overhead, the large golden moon shines radiantly.
Is it the mercy of the moon?
My headache has disappeared and my head is in a daze.
Under the moon.
As if under a spell, I continue walking.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
闇に包まれた死都を歩く。
　ポケットにはナイフの感触があった。
　……信じられない。
　自分でも意識しないまま、俺はナイフをポケットに収めていたらしい。
　たぶん、きっと。
　いつでも人を殺せるように。
lines.label: s289
lines.maoEnglish:
I cross the dead city wrapped in darkness. There is the shape of a knife in my pocket. …Impossible. Without even noticing, I must have slipped it inside.
Probably. Surely. So that I could kill someone whenever I pleased.
lines.mao_english:

I can feel the knife in my pocket.
…… I can't believe it.
Even without thinking about it, I seemed to have put it there.
Probably,
so that at any time, I can kill someone.

夜の公園。
　何もかもあやふやな視界の中、唯一つはっきりとする影がある。
「――――――」
　なんとなく。
俺ではないオレが、こうなることを、望んでいたらしい。
　月光は強く。
　太陽の明かりほど眩しい月下。
　そこに、白い装束のアルクェイドが立っていた。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
The park at night. Everything in my vision was indistinct except for a single, sharply defined figure. “……” Somehow, the me who was not me seemed to have wanted this to happen.
The moonlight was fierce, almost as dazzling as the sun. Beneath it stood Arcueid, dressed all in white.

lines.mirrorMoon:
Night hangs over the park.
In the middle of my hazy vision, there is one figure that looks clear.
"------"
For some reason, it seems like the other "me" wanted this.

The moonlight is strong.
Under the light as bright as the sun.
There, Arcueid stands dressed in white.

lines.japanese:
「久しぶり。
今夜はいい月ね、志貴」
「――アルクェイド。
おまえ、帰ったんじゃなかったのか」
「いいえ。
わたし、まだ自分の目的を果たしてないもの。
このまま帰るわけにはいかないでしょう？」
―――無造作に。
　アルクェイドは、紅い瞳で俺を見つめた。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
“It’s been a while. Beautiful moon tonight, Shiki.” “Arcueid… I thought you’d gone home.”
“No. I still haven’t accomplished what I came here to do. I can hardly go home now, can I?”
Without the slightest ceremony, Arcueid fixed her crimson eyes on me.

Didn't you go back?"
"No, I haven't fulfilled my objective yet.

lines.japanese:
「っ―――――」
　呼吸が止まる。
　先輩と対峙した時とは比べ物にならないぐらいの、異質なまでの圧迫感。
「アルクェイド……おまえ、何の―――」
　つもりなんだ、という質問は言葉にならなかった。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
“—!”
My breath stopped.
The alien pressure she exerted was beyond comparison with what I had felt facing Ciel.
“Arcueid… what are you—”
The rest of the question never became words.
lines.mao_english:
“—!”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Ts------"
My breathing stops in my throat.
An unnatural pressure, nothing like when I confronted Senpai.
"Arcueid…… What are, you---"
Planning to do.
But I couldn't finish.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Ts------"

lines.japanese:
……視界がゆらぐ。
　頭の中で、何か、自分とは違う誰かが叫び続けている。
　まるで月に咆く獣のような、その激しさ。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: …My vision swayed. Someone who wasn’t me screamed ceaselessly inside my head, with the savagery of a beast baying at the moon.
lines.mao_english: …My vision swayed. Someone who wasn’t me screamed ceaselessly inside my head, with the savagery of a beast baying at the moon.
lines.mirrorMoon:
…… My vision wavers.
Inside my head, someone other than me continues to scream.
Almost like a beast howling at the moon.
lines.mirror_moon:
…… My vision wavers.
Inside my head, someone other than me continues to scream.
Almost like a beast howling at the moon.

lines.japanese:
「……ふうん。
逃げ出さないなんて、覚悟は出来ているってワケ？」
　赤い瞳は、まるで俺を憎むべき敵のように凝視してくる。
「ぁ――――――」
　息ができない。
　喉が動かない。
　そんな余分な真似をすれば―――次の瞬間、この首が千切られてしまうだろう。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “……Well. You haven’t run. Does that mean you’re prepared?” Her red eyes stared at me as though I were an enemy she despised. “Ah…” I couldn’t breathe. My throat refused to move. If I attempted anything so unnecessary, my head would be torn from my neck in the next instant.
lines.mao_english: “……Well. You haven’t run. Does that mean you’re prepared?” Her red eyes stared at me as though I were an enemy she despised. “Ah…” I couldn’t breathe. My throat refused to move. If I attempted anything so unnecessary, my head would be torn from my neck in the next instant.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hmm.
You're not running away, so you're prepared?"
Her red eyes stare at me, as if she is looking at a hated enemy.
"A------"
I can't breathe.
My throat doesn't move.
If I do such extraneous movement---she would tear it out at that moment.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「それじゃ殺すけど、最期に言っておく事はある？」
「―――――――――」
　恐ろしくて声さえ出せない。
　ただ、もし満足に喋れるのなら―――どうして俺をそんなに本気になって殺そうとしているかって、聞きたかった。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
“I’m going to kill you now. Any last words?”
“……” Terror had taken even my voice. If I could have spoken, I would only have asked why she was trying so earnestly to kill me.
lines.mao_english:
“I’m going to kill you now. Any last words?”
“……” Terror had taken even my voice. If I could have spoken, I would only have asked why she was trying so earnestly to kill me.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Then I'll kill you, but do you have any last words?"
"---------"
I'm so scared I can't even speak.
But, if I could speak---I want to ask her why she wants to kill me.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Then I'll kill you, but do you have any last words?"
"---------"

「え―――？
　うそ、信じられない。
志貴ったらまだ気がついてないのね」
　クスリと微笑って、アルクェイドは一歩こちらに近づいた。
　かつん、という乾いた足音が公園に響き渡る。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
“What? No—I don’t believe it. Shiki, you still haven’t realized?”
Arcueid gave a soft, amused smile and stepped closer.
The dry click of her heel rang across the park.
lines.mao_english:

"Eh---?
No way, I can't believe it.
You haven't realized it yet?"
With a giggle, Arcueid takes a step closer.
The dry sound of her footsteps echoes through the park.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Eh---?

lines.japanese:
「わたしも騙されたわ。
まさか、貴方がロアだったなんて、ね」
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “You fooled me too. I never imagined that you were Roa.”
lines.mao_english: “You fooled me too. I never imagined that you were Roa.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"I was also deceived.
I didn't think you were Roa."
lines.mirror_moon:
"I was also deceived.
I didn't think you were Roa."

lines.japanese:
言って。
　アルクェイドはほんのわずかな憐憫と、この上ない娯楽を見つけた子供のように、嬉しげに目を細めた。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: With the faintest trace of pity, Arcueid narrowed her eyes in delight, like a child discovering the finest game in the world.
lines.mao_english: With the faintest trace of pity, Arcueid narrowed her eyes in delight, like a child discovering the finest game in the world.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Saying that,
she shows just a brief moment of pity.
Then, her eyes light up with pure delight like a happy child.
lines.mirror_moon:
Saying that,
she shows just a brief moment of pity.

lines.japanese:
パキン、と。
　頭の中で、何かが弾けた。
　それは決定的に、およそ壊滅的なまでの、すでに不能ですらある、絶望的な亀裂だった。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: Crack. Something split inside my head. It was a final fracture—catastrophic, hopeless, breaking something already beyond repair.
lines.mao_english: Crack. Something split inside my head. It was a final fracture—catastrophic, hopeless, breaking something already beyond repair.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Snap.
Something cracks in my head.
It was a definite, most terrible, already nonfunctional, desperate crack.
lines.mirror_moon:
Snap.
Something cracks in my head.
It was a definite, most terrible, already nonfunctional, desperate crack.

lines.japanese:
「な―――――」
　声が漏れる。
　何を。
　何を言っているんだろう、こいつは。
「それで、どうなの志貴？
　自分の中にロアがいるっていう感想は？」
　ゾッとするぐらい親しげな声で、形容しがたいほどの殺気をこめて、白い吸血姫はそう言った。
「俺――――俺、は」
　ロアなんていうヤツは知らない。
　俺の中にあるのは、自分でもワケが解らない破壊衝動だけだ。
　何の意味もなく琥珀さんを殺そうとして、それに快楽を見出している衝動だ、け――――
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
“Wh—” A sound escaped me. What? What was she talking about?
“So, Shiki? How does it feel to have Roa inside you?” The white vampire princess spoke with a friendliness that chilled the blood, her voice laden with indescribable bloodlust. “I—I…” I knew no one called Roa. Inside me was only a destructive impulse I couldn’t understand—the urge that had tried to kill Kohaku for no reason and found pleasure in the thought. Only that—
lines.mao_english:

How does it feel to have Roa inside you?” The white vampire princess spoke with a friendliness that chilled the blood, her voice laden with indescribable bloodlust. “I—I…” I knew no one called Roa. Inside me was only a destructive impulse I couldn’t understand—the urge that had tried to kill Kohaku for no reason and found pleasure in the thought. Only that—
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Wha------"
My voice leaks out.
What.
What is she saying?
"So how is it, Shiki?
How does it feel to have Roa inside you?"
The white vampire princess speaks with a kind voice as she stares with hostility.
"I-----I."
I don't know about this Roa guy.
What's inside me is only this inexplicable urge to destroy things.
Like trying to kill Kohaku-san without any reason, and getting pleasure out of seeing it.
That's, all-----

「わたしの下僕になるのなら、ロアの侵食は止めてあげるわ。
　そのままじゃ貴方はロアに乗っ取られるんだから、考えるまでもない事だと思うけど」
「……簡単に言ってくれるけどさ。
アルクェイド、おまえはどうやって俺の中のロアを止められるっていうんだ」
「あら、ロアを止められるのはきっと貴方だけよ、志貴。
　けどその方法では志貴自身も死んでしまう。
　わたしの方法は志貴自身を強くするだけ。
貴方がロアより強い心を持てば、ロアがどう暴れようと関係ないでしょう？」
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “Become my servant and I’ll halt Roa’s encroachment. As you are now, he’ll eventually take you over. There’s hardly anything to consider.” “…Easy for you to say. How exactly do you plan to stop Roa inside me?” “Oh, I’m sure the only person who can stop Roa is you, Shiki. But that method would kill you as well. My method merely makes you stronger. If your heart becomes stronger than Roa’s, it won’t matter how violently he struggles, will it?”
lines.mao_english: “Become my servant and I’ll halt Roa’s encroachment. As you are now, he’ll eventually take you over. There’s hardly anything to consider.” “…Easy for you to say. How exactly do you plan to stop Roa inside me?” “Oh, I’m sure the only person who can stop Roa is you, Shiki. But that method would kill you as well. My method merely makes you stronger. If your heart becomes stronger than Roa’s, it won’t matter how violently he struggles, will it?”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"If you are willing to become my servant, I will stop Roa from consuming you.
I don't think you even need to think about it, seeing how Roa will consume you like this."
"…… You say it so simply, but how do you intend to stop this Roa inside me?"
"Huh?
The only one who can stop Roa is you, Shiki.
But that method would mean your death.
My method is simply strengthening you.
As long as your will is stronger than Roa's, then it doesn't matter how much he rages in you, right?"

lines.japanese:
バキン、ともう一度頭痛が叩きつけられる。
　ロアが暴れている。
　騙されるな。
あの女は、おまえを人形にするつもりだ、と暴れている。
　……その衝動を鵜呑みする気はない。
　ないけど、ロアの意見には賛成だ。
　俺は、俺のままでいたいんだ。
　ロアから逃げるためにアルクェイドの下僕になるなんて本末転倒じゃないか。
　それに、第一。
　俺には、シエル先輩がいる。
　明日学校にいって、あの人に相談すればきっと解決策ぐらい見つけてくれる―――。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
Crack—the pain smashed into me again. Roa was raging. Don’t be fooled. That woman means to make you her puppet. …I had no intention of swallowing his warning whole. But I agreed with him. I wanted to remain myself. Becoming Arcueid’s servant to escape Roa would defeat the entire point.
Besides, I still had Ciel. If I went to school tomorrow and asked her for help, she would surely find some answer.
lines.mao_english:
Crack—the pain smashed into me again. Roa was raging. Don’t be fooled. That woman means to make you her puppet. …I had no intention of swallowing his warning whole. But I agreed with him. I wanted to remain myself. Becoming Arcueid’s servant to escape Roa would defeat the entire point.
Besides, I still had Ciel. If I went to school tomorrow and asked her for help, she would surely find some answer.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Something bursts in my head again.
Roa keeps raging.
Don't let her fool you, he rages.
This woman wants to make you her puppet.
…… I don't intend to give in to that impulse.
But, I agree with Roa.
I want to stay as myself.
To become Arcueid's servant to get away from Roa is getting my priorities wrong.
And, in the first place,
there is Ciel-senpai.
If I go to school tomorrow and talk to her about it, I bet she can come up with a solution to this---.

lines.japanese:
「…………っ」
　ぎり、と歯を食いしばって、頭痛を押さえつけた。
　メガネを外す。
　ナイフをポケットから出す。
　刃を出して、自分の目の高さにあげて、両手で構えた。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “……!” I clenched my teeth and forced the headache down. I removed my glasses, drew the knife from my pocket, snapped out the blade, and raised it in both hands before my eyes.
lines.mao_english: “……!” I clenched my teeth and forced the headache down. I removed my glasses, drew the knife from my pocket, snapped out the blade, and raised it in both hands before my eyes.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
Gritting my teeth, I resist the pounding in my head.
I take off my glasses,
and get my knife from my pocket.
I take the blade out and hold it at eye level.
lines.mirror_moon:
"…………"
Gritting my teeth, I resist the pounding in my head.
I take off my glasses,
and get my knife from my pocket.
I take the blade out and hold it at eye level.

lines.japanese:
「――――志貴」
「お断りだ。
悪いけど、俺はおまえの物になんかならない」
「そっか。
しかたないな、なら力ずくね」
　かつん、という硬い足音。
「貴方には一度殺されたこともあるし。
一度、お返しをしてあげなくっちゃって思ってたんだ」
　突風をともなって、白い影が迫ってくる。
――――瞬間。
　戦いは、始まっていた。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
“Shiki…” “No. Sorry, but I’m not going to belong to you.”
“I see. Then I suppose I’ll have to use force.”
Her heel struck the ground with a hard click.
“You did kill me once, after all. I’ve been meaning to return the favor.”
A white shape hurtled at me on a gale of displaced air.
In that instant, the fight had already begun.
lines.mao_english:

“I see. Then I suppose I’ll have to use force.”

“You did kill me once, after all. I’ve been meaning to return the favor.”
A white shape hurtled at me on a gale of displaced air.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"----Shiki."
"I refuse.
Sorry, but I won't be yours to possess."
"I see.
Then, I guess it'll just have to be by force."
A hard footstep cracks through the air.
"You killed me once, so I always thought I should pay you back."
Her white figure rushes forth with a gust of wind.
----In that instant,
the fight begins.

lines.japanese:
ギィィィン。
　アルクェイドの爪と、俺のナイフがぶつかり合う。
　金色の月の下、走りこんできたアルクェイドの姿は、敵だとしても美しかった。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
Krrrng! Arcueid’s claws collided with my knife.
Beneath the golden moon, even the sight of Arcueid charging as my enemy was beautiful.
lines.mao_english:
Krrrng! Arcueid’s claws collided with my knife.
Beneath the golden moon, even the sight of Arcueid charging as my enemy was beautiful.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Clang!
Her claws meet my knife.
Under the golden moon, even if she is my enemy, her figure is still beautiful.
lines.mirror_moon:
Clang!
Her claws meet my knife.
Under the golden moon, even if she is my enemy, her figure is still beautiful.

lines.japanese:
ギィィィィン。
　また弾けあう。
　正直、俺にはアルクェイドの動きなんて見えていない。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: Krrrng! We sprang apart again. To be honest, I couldn’t see Arcueid’s movements at all.
lines.mao_english: Krrrng! We sprang apart again. To be honest, I couldn’t see Arcueid’s movements at all.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Clang!
We repel each other again.
To be honest, I can't even see her movements.
lines.mirror_moon:
Clang!
We repel each other again.
To be honest, I can't even see her movements.

lines.japanese:
ギィィィィン。
　さらに弾く。
　アルクェイドは全然本気でやっていない。
　けど、それでも俺の手足を引き裂くぐらいは容易なんだろう。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: Krrrng! Another parry. Arcueid wasn’t fighting seriously in the least. Even so, tearing off my arms and legs would probably have been easy for her.
lines.mao_english: Krrrng! Another parry. Arcueid wasn’t fighting seriously in the least. Even so, tearing off my arms and legs would probably have been easy for her.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Clang!
We repel each other once more.
Arcueid isn't serious at all.
But still, it should be easy for her to rip off my arms and legs.
lines.mirror_moon:
Clang!
We repel each other once more.
Arcueid isn't serious at all.
But still, it should be easy for her to rip off my arms and legs.

lines.japanese:
ギィィィィン。
　まだ弾く。
　体が動く。
俺は何も考えていないのと同じだ。
　この手足、この体が、ただ死にたくないとう号令のもと、かってにアルクェイドの爪を弾いている。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: Krrrng! Another parry, and another. My body moved while my mind did nothing. My arms, my legs—this whole body—deflected Arcueid’s claws on its own, obeying a single command: I don’t want to die.
lines.mao_english: Krrrng! Another parry, and another. My body moved while my mind did nothing. My arms, my legs—this whole body—deflected Arcueid’s claws on its own, obeying a single command: I don’t want to die.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Clang.
We repel each other again.
My body moves without thinking.
My arms and legs, this body, with just the intention of not dying, fends off Arcueid's claws by itself.
lines.mirror_moon:
Clang.
We repel each other again.
My body moves without thinking.
My arms and legs, this body, with just the intention of not dying, fends off Arcueid's claws by itself.

lines.japanese:
「く―――――」
　口元が皮肉げに歪んだ。
　あまり認めたくないが、俺の体は遥かに人間ばなれしてしまっているみたいだ。
　夜のうちなら、遠野志貴はかつてのシキという男並みに、校舎の三階ぐらいなら楽に飛び降りられるだろう。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “Damn…” My mouth twisted in bitter amusement. I hated to admit it, but my body had strayed far beyond anything human. At night, Shiki Tohno could probably leap from the third floor of the school building as easily as the man once called SHIKI.
lines.mao_english: “Damn…” My mouth twisted in bitter amusement. I hated to admit it, but my body had strayed far beyond anything human. At night, Shiki Tohno could probably leap from the third floor of the school building as easily as the man once called SHIKI.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Tch-----"
My lips curl in irony.
I don't want to admit it, but it seems my body has become beyond that of a human's.
In the dead of night, it seems Tohno Shiki has become like SHIKI, probably able to easily jump off the third floor of a building and be just fine.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Tch-----"
My lips curl in irony.
I don't want to admit it, but it seems my body has become beyond that of a human's.
In the dead of night, it seems Tohno Shiki has become like SHIKI, probably able to easily jump off the third floor of a building and be just fine.

lines.japanese:
ギィ、ィィィ。
　だが、それも限界だった。
　初めから―――アルクェイドには勝てっこないって解っていた。
　そもそも、俺の唯一の武器である『線』が視えない。
　俺には彼女を傷つける手段がない。
　いつかアルクェイドが言っていた。
　夜であるのなら、アルクェイドは死の要因がなくなる生命だと。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
Krrr— But that was my limit. I had known from the beginning that I could never defeat Arcueid. For one thing, I couldn’t see the “lines”—my only weapon.
I had no way to harm her. Arcueid had once told me that at night she became a form of life from which every cause of death disappeared.
lines.mao_english:
Krrr— But that was my limit. I had known from the beginning that I could never defeat Arcueid. For one thing, I couldn’t see the “lines”—my only weapon.
I had no way to harm her. Arcueid had once told me that at night she became a form of life from which every cause of death disappeared.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Cl, ang.
But, this is it.
From the very start---I knew I couldn't win against Arcueid.
First of all, I can't see any "lines" on her.
I have no way of hurting her.
Arcueid said it once.
That during nighttime, there is nothing which can cause her death.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
ギイン。
　勢いよくナイフが弾かれる。
　アルクェイドの腕の一振りで、俺は大きく弾き飛ばされた。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: Clang! My knife was flung aside. A single sweep of Arcueid’s arm sent me flying.
lines.mao_english: Clang! My knife was flung aside. A single sweep of Arcueid’s arm sent me flying.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Clang.
She hits my knife.
With just a swing of her arm, I fly through the air.
lines.mirror_moon:
Clang.
She hits my knife.
With just a swing of her arm, I fly through the air.

lines.japanese:
「くっ――――！」
　なんとか地面に着地して、ナイフを構える。
　いくら睨んでも、アルクェイドの体には『線』一つ視えない。
「くそ、なんてデタラメなんだ、アイツは……！」
――――まったくもってその通りだ。
　太陽の恩恵がないこの夜のなか。
　月の姫に挑むということは、あまりにも無謀すぎた。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “Guh—!” I somehow landed on my feet and raised the knife. No matter how hard I stared, not a single “line” appeared on Arcueid’s body. “Damn it, she’s impossible…!” And that was precisely the truth. Here in the night, beyond the sun’s blessing, challenging the princess of the moon was sheer madness.
lines.mao_english: “Guh—!” I somehow landed on my feet and raised the knife. No matter how hard I stared, not a single “line” appeared on Arcueid’s body. “Damn it, she’s impossible…!” And that was precisely the truth. Here in the night, beyond the sun’s blessing, challenging the princess of the moon was sheer madness.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"K-----!"
I manage to land on the ground and ready my knife.
No matter how much I look, I can't see any "lines" on her.
"Damn it.
What nonsense you are……!"
----Yes, I am so right.
In the deep night without the mercy of the sun,
facing the princess of the moon is too reckless.

lines.japanese:
「は――――あ、あ」
　喉があつい。
　心臓が爆発しそう。
　気がつけば、俺はアルクェイドと出会った時から彼女の紅い瞳に威圧されて、呼吸さえ満足にさせてもらっていなかった。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “Hah—ah…” My throat burned. My heart felt ready to burst. Only now did I realize that her crimson eyes had held me under such crushing pressure from the instant we met that I had scarcely been allowed to breathe.
lines.mao_english: “Hah—ah…” My throat burned. My heart felt ready to burst. Only now did I realize that her crimson eyes had held me under such crushing pressure from the instant we met that I had scarcely been allowed to breathe.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----ah, ha."
My throat is burning.
My heart feels like it'll explode.
I realize that since I saw her tonight, I was under the pressure of her crimson eyes and I haven't been able to breathe well.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Ha----ah, ha."
My throat is burning.
My heart feels like it'll explode.
I realize that since I saw her tonight, I was under the pressure of her crimson eyes and I haven't been able to breathe well.

lines.japanese:
「どう？
　少しは目が覚めた？」
　アルクェイドは息一つあがっていない。
　こっちは酸欠で今にも心臓が止まりそうだっていうのに、いい気なもんだ。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “Well? Are you awake now?” Arcueid wasn’t even winded. I was close to cardiac arrest from lack of air, and there she stood without a care in the world.
lines.mao_english: “Well? Are you awake now?” Arcueid wasn’t even winded. I was close to cardiac arrest from lack of air, and there she stood without a care in the world.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Have you realized it yet?"
She isn't even out of breath.
Even though I'm gasping for air and my heart feels like it'll stop, she's completely relaxed.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Have you realized it yet?"
She isn't even out of breath.
Even though I'm gasping for air and my heart feels like it'll stop, she's completely relaxed.

lines.japanese:
「くそ――――おまえこそ、少しは頭を冷やせって言うんだ――――」
　乱れた呼吸を整えながら、少しずつアルクェイドから離れる。
　……アルクェイドはまったく本気になっていない。
ネロやロアのような威圧感こそないものの、ここまで―――自分と相手の『存在』のレベルの違いを感じさせられるなんて、思わなかった。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “Damn you… You’re the one who needs to cool your head…” I edged away from Arcueid as I struggled to steady my breathing. …She wasn’t remotely serious. She lacked the oppressive aura of Nrvnqsr or Roa, yet never had I felt so nakedly the difference between the level of my existence and another’s.
lines.mao_english: “Damn you… You’re the one who needs to cool your head…” I edged away from Arcueid as I struggled to steady my breathing. …She wasn’t remotely serious. She lacked the oppressive aura of Nrvnqsr or Roa, yet never had I felt so nakedly the difference between the level of my existence and another’s.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Damn----What about you, have you cooled your head----"
Trying to control my breathing, I step back from her little by little.
…… Arcueid isn't fighting me seriously at all.
She doesn't have the pressure like Roa or Nrvnqsr, I never thought I would feel this much difference between us.

lines.japanese:
「もう、しょうがないなぁ。
志貴は一度ぐらい殺されないと判ってくれないみたいだね」
　はあ、と面倒くさそうにため息をついて。
　アルクェイドは、俺の真後ろに立っていた。
「ぐっ――――！」
　ガン、という音が後頭部でなった。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, Shiki. It seems you won’t understand until you’ve been killed at least once.” She sighed as though the whole business were a nuisance.
Arcueid was standing directly behind me.
“Guh—!” Something struck the back of my skull with a boom.
lines.mao_english:
“Honestly, Shiki. It seems you won’t understand until you’ve been killed at least once.” She sighed as though the whole business were a nuisance.
Arcueid was standing directly behind me.
“Guh—!” Something struck the back of my skull with a boom.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Oh well.
It seems you won't understand until you die once, Shiki."
She gives an impatient sigh.
Arcueid stands directly behind me.
"Gh----!"
I hear a sound from behind my head.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Oh well.
It seems you won't understand until you die once, Shiki."
She gives an impatient sigh.
Arcueid stands directly behind me.
"Gh----!"
I hear a sound from behind my head.

lines.japanese:
――――瞬きをする間もない。
　アルクェイドは無造作に俺を地面に押し付けた。
　両肩にはアルクェイドの体重がかかっている。
　倒された。
　一瞬で、わけもわからないまま、アルクェイドに押さえつけられてしまった。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: Before I could blink, Arcueid casually slammed me against the ground. Her weight bore down on both my shoulders. I had been taken down—pinned beneath her in one incomprehensible instant.
lines.mao_english: Before I could blink, Arcueid casually slammed me against the ground. Her weight bore down on both my shoulders. I had been taken down—pinned beneath her in one incomprehensible instant.
lines.mirrorMoon:
----There's not even time to blink.
She effortlessly pushes me to the ground.
Her body pushes up against my shoulders.
I'm down.
In an instant, without me knowing what's going on, Arcueid has pinned me down.
lines.mirror_moon:
----There's not even time to blink.
She effortlessly pushes me to the ground.
Her body pushes up against my shoulders.
I'm down.
In an instant, without me knowing what's going on, Arcueid has pinned me down.

lines.japanese:
「――――――」
　アルクェイドは無言で、俺を睨みつけてくる。
　両肩にかかった体重。
　今すぐ俺をどうにかできるのに、まるで躊躇っているかのように、アルクェイドは止まっている。
「――――――」
　息を飲む。
　けど、それはアルクェイドの静寂だったのかも、しれない。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “……” Arcueid glared down in silence. Her weight pressed into my shoulders. She could do anything she wished to me, yet she had stopped, almost as though she were hesitating. “……” I caught my breath. Or perhaps that breathless pause belonged to Arcueid.
lines.mao_english: “……” Arcueid glared down in silence. Her weight pressed into my shoulders. She could do anything she wished to me, yet she had stopped, almost as though she were hesitating. “……” I caught my breath. Or perhaps that breathless pause belonged to Arcueid.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Arcueid glares at me without speaking.
Her body weight against my shoulders.
She stops as if hesitating over what to do with me.
"------"
I gasp.
But, it might have been just her silence.
lines.mirror_moon:
"------"
Arcueid glares at me without speaking.
Her body weight against my shoulders.
She stops as if hesitating over what to do with me.
"------"
I gasp.
But, it might have been just her silence.

"------"

Now that we are so close---I may be able to see it.
lines.mirror_moon:

　今までのような頭痛じゃなくて―――本当に、脳に亀裂が走ってしまいそうな、おと。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
I stared hard at Arcueid’s body.
Something creaked deep in my skull. This was no ordinary headache. It sounded as though a crack were truly opening through my brain.

Completely unlike the pain of my headache before---as if it really were tearing itself apart.

「――――――っ」
　それでもだめだ。
　アルクェイドという存在から『死』が読み取れない。
　日中ならともかく、夜においてはコイツはかぎりなく完璧に近い命、死という概念を持たない存在なんだから。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “—!” Still nothing. I could read no “death” in the existence called Arcueid. In daylight, perhaps—but at night she was a life infinitely close to perfection, a being without the very concept of death.
lines.mao_english: “—!” Still nothing. I could read no “death” in the existence called Arcueid. In daylight, perhaps—but at night she was a life infinitely close to perfection, a being without the very concept of death.

"-------"
But it's no good.
I can't read the "death" from an existence like Arcueid.
Daytime might be different, but at night, she is close to being a perfect life form that doesn't even carry the concept of death.

……そうね、だから貴方のことも見逃してあげてもよかったんだ」

“Ar… cueid.” Her eyes saw nothing. She tried to rise on one arm, only to collapse every time.
Her hand slipped in the pool of her own blood, staining her body redder with every fall. Again and again she tried to rise, slipped, and fell. …She seemed to relish even that wretched spectacle.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Ar---cueid."
Her eyes are looking at nothing.
She tries to lift herself up with one hand, but every time, she collapses back down to the ground.
She slips on her own pool of blood, and each time, her body gets redder.
Over, and over.
She tries to stand up, slips, and falls.
…… It seems as if she's enjoying that cycle of failure.

「―――――――」

　俺という意思が流される。
融かされる。
翻弄される。

lines.maoEnglish:
“J-just… wait.”
“……” I couldn’t move. Arcueid’s voice, her body, her will—all of it poured irresistibly into my mind.
The will that was me was swept away, dissolved, toyed with. The world spun round and round.
And amid that whirl, her vision entered me.

壊す。
壊す。
壊す。
　少しずつ、一息に、この上なく優しく、痺れるぐらい残酷に、あの命を犯しつくそう。

lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
Break him. Break him. Break him. Slowly, all at once, with unsurpassable tenderness and cruelty sweet enough to numb—violate that life until nothing remains.
Yes.
The instant I tear off his limbs, wrench open his ribs, twist out his entrails, crush the throat that begs for mercy, bite his eyes to pulp, split his skull, and smear his brains across the earth like butter—!

　喉からこみあげてくる血液を吐き出して、廊下に倒れこんだ。
　目の前には。
　俺より少し前に絶命した、彼女の体が倒れている。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
“—Ghh.” Blood surges backward from my ruined heart. I vomit what wells into my throat and crumple onto the corridor floor.
Before my eyes lies her body, dead only moments before mine will be.
lines.mao_english:
“—Ghh.” Blood surges backward from my ruined heart. I vomit what wells into my throat and crumple onto the corridor floor.
Before my eyes lies her body, dead only moments before mine will be.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"------Ga, hu."
My blood flow reverses through my lanced heart.
Coughing up blood, I collapse onto the ground.
Before my eyes,
the body of the one who died slightly ahead of me lies on the floor.
lines.mirror_moon:
"------Ga, hu."

the body of the one who died slightly ahead of me lies on the floor.

lines.japanese:
「――――なんて」
　わかって、いたのか。
「――――愚か、な」
　初めから―――罪があるとしたら自分にだけだって、わかって、いたのか、あなたは。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “How could you…” You knew? “You… fool.” Did you know from the start that if either of us bore any guilt, it belonged to you alone?
lines.mao_english: “How could you…” You knew? “You… fool.” Did you know from the start that if either of us bore any guilt, it belonged to you alone?
lines.mirrorMoon:
"----How--"
Did you, know?
"----foolish."
Did you know from the beginning---that if there was such a thing as sin, it would only be for you?
lines.mirror_moon:
"----How--"
Did you, know?
"----foolish."
Did you know from the beginning---that if there was such a thing as sin, it would only be for you?

lines.japanese:
「はっ――――あ」
　手足の感覚がなくなっていく。
　意識も。
血液の供給が途絶えて、あと数秒と保つまい。
　あの銃剣で刺された瞬間。
　自分の中で、何か古い本のようなモノが、ページを撒き散らして消えていくイメージがあった。
　おそらく。
それで、ロアと呼ばれたモノは霧散したのだろう。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ah.” Feeling drains from my limbs. My consciousness follows. With the blood supply cut off, it cannot last more than a few seconds. At the instant her gun-blade struck me, I saw something within myself like an ancient book, scattering its pages as it vanished.
Perhaps that was the thing called Roa dispersing into nothing.
lines.mao_english:
“Hah—ah.” Feeling drains from my limbs. My consciousness follows. With the blood supply cut off, it cannot last more than a few seconds. At the instant her gun-blade struck me, I saw something within myself like an ancient book, scattering its pages as it vanished.
Perhaps that was the thing called Roa dispersing into nothing.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----ah."
The sensation in my limbs fades away.
My consciousness, too.
It will be seconds before I bleed to death.
The instant I was stabbed,
I had a vision of something like an old book, scattering and crumbling away page by page.
Probably, with that, the thing called Roa was dispersed.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Ha----ah."
The sensation in my limbs fades away.
My consciousness, too.
It will be seconds before I bleed to death.
The instant I was stabbed,
I had a vision of something like an old book, scattering and crumbling away page by page.
Probably, with that, the thing called Roa was dispersed.

lines.japanese:
「…………」
　何も思い浮かばない。
　彼女が初めから、自分の命と引き換えに俺を殺そうとしたこと。
　それがせめてもの罰だと思ったのか。
―――バカげてる。
　そんなもの―――何の意味も、ない。
「―――それでも」
　俺に謝ることなく死んだのは、悲しかった。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
“…” Nothing comes to mind. From the very beginning, she had meant to kill me at the cost of her own life. Did she believe that would serve as some small punishment?
Absurd. It means nothing. Nothing at all.
“Even so…” It hurts that she died without ever apologizing to me.
lines.mao_english:
“…” Nothing comes to mind. From the very beginning, she had meant to kill me at the cost of her own life. Did she believe that would serve as some small punishment?
Absurd. It means nothing. Nothing at all.
“Even so…” It hurts that she died without ever apologizing to me.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
I can't think.
From the very beginning, she planned to give her life to take mine.
Did she think that was her punishment?
---How foolish.
There's no---meaning in that.
"---Still."
I was sad that she died before she apologized to me.
lines.mirror_moon:
"…………"
I can't think.
From the very beginning, she planned to give her life to take mine.
Did she think that was her punishment?
---How foolish.
There's no---meaning in that.
"---Still."
I was sad that she died before she apologized to me.

lines.japanese:
ごめんなさい、と言ってくれれば、それで彼女の気持ちも少しは救われただろうに。
……この人は、それさえ口にできなかったのか。
　謝って償える事じゃないって解っていたから、彼女は最後まで謝らなかった。
　その決意。
そこまで追いこんだのが自分だという事が、頭にくる。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish:
If she had only said she was sorry, perhaps it would have brought her some small measure of peace. But she could not even permit herself that. Knowing an apology could never repay what she had done, she refused to offer one even at the end.
That resolve of hers—and the knowledge that I drove her to it—makes me furious.
lines.mao_english:
If she had only said she was sorry, perhaps it would have brought her some small measure of peace. But she could not even permit herself that. Knowing an apology could never repay what she had done, she refused to offer one even at the end.
That resolve of hers—and the knowledge that I drove her to it—makes me furious.
lines.mirrorMoon:
If she could have apologized to me, then I bet she would have felt some relief…… But, she couldn't even say that.
Since she knew it was something that wasn't atoneable by apology, she didn't apologize to the very end.
That determination.
It makes me angry that I made her go that far.
lines.mirror_moon:
If she could have apologized to me, then I bet she would have felt some relief…… But, she couldn't even say that.
Since she knew it was something that wasn't atoneable by apology, she didn't apologize to the very end.
That determination.
It makes me angry that I made her go that far.

lines.japanese:
「なんだ、結局――――」
　俺は、この人が、好きだったのか。
　最後まで。
　こうして死の直前まで彼女を悲しいと思ってしまうぐらい、大切だったんだ。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “So that was it…” I loved her after all. Right to the end. She mattered so much that even on the threshold of death, my heart still aches for her.
lines.mao_english: “So that was it…” I loved her after all. Right to the end. She mattered so much that even on the threshold of death, my heart still aches for her.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"What.
In the end----"
I liked her?
Until the very end.
Feeling sad like this until my own death, she was that dear to me.
lines.mirror_moon:
"What.
In the end----"
I liked her?
Until the very end.
Feeling sad like this until my own death, she was that dear to me.

lines.japanese:
「―――――っ」
　軽く咳き込んで、血を吐いた。
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: “—” A small cough brings up another mouthful of blood.
lines.mao_english: “—” A small cough brings up another mouthful of blood.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"------Tss."
I cough weakly and spit out blood.
lines.mirror_moon:
"------Tss."
I cough weakly and spit out blood.

lines.japanese:
それで終わり。
　ぼんやりと月を見上げたまま、胡乱な意思のまま、いつのまにか、眠って、い――――
lines.label: s289a
lines.maoEnglish: And that is the end. I gaze vaguely up at the moon, my thoughts adrift, and before I know it I am falling… asle—
lines.mao_english: And that is the end. I gaze vaguely up at the moon, my thoughts adrift, and before I know it I am falling… asle—
lines.mirrorMoon:
It's all over.
Staring dazedly at the moon, with these strange thoughts, I drift off to slee----
lines.mirror_moon:
It's all over.
Staring dazedly at the moon, with these strange thoughts, I drift off to slee----

lines.japanese:
……三時間目は悲しいお話でした。
　なんとか一人で解決しようとした遠野くんは立派ですが、今回はそれが裏目に出てしまったようです。
　ここは頼りになる先輩に相談して、なんとかピンチをしのいじゃってください。
lines.label: s523
lines.maoEnglish: …Lesson three was a sad one. It was admirable of Tohno to try solving everything alone, but this time it worked against him. Consult the senior you can depend on and let her help you out of this predicament.
lines.mao_english: …Lesson three was a sad one. It was admirable of Tohno to try solving everything alone, but this time it worked against him. Consult the senior you can depend on and let her help you out of this predicament.
lines.mirrorMoon:
…… The third period class was a sad story.
You really were splendid in trying to resolve everything by yourself, but it seems to have backfired this time.
Consult your reliable Senpai, and please make your way through this trouble.
lines.mirror_moon:
…… The third period class was a sad story.
You really were splendid in trying to resolve everything by yourself, but it seems to have backfired this time.
Consult your reliable Senpai, and please make your way through this trouble.

lines.japanese:
――――それと！
　それ以外でここにきてしまった遠野くん！
　残念です、もーちょっとでクライマックスだっていうのに、シエルさんとの絆が足りません。
　再提出です。
　随分前に戻って、こまめにシエルさんと仲良くなってください。
　ポイントとしては多々ありますが、最大のポイントは六日目の夜の出来事でしょう。
lines.label: s523
lines.maoEnglish: —And another thing! Tohno, if you arrived here by any other route, I’m afraid your bond with Ciel is too weak, even though you were almost at the climax. Resubmit your work. Go back quite a way and take every opportunity to grow closer to her. There are many important moments, but the greatest one is probably what happens on the night of day six.
lines.mao_english: —And another thing! Tohno, if you arrived here by any other route, I’m afraid your bond with Ciel is too weak, even though you were almost at the climax. Resubmit your work. Go back quite a way and take every opportunity to grow closer to her. There are many important moments, but the greatest one is probably what happens on the night of day six.
lines.mirrorMoon:
----And!
For you Tohno-kuns who came here for some other reason.
Unfortunately, even though you were so close to the climax, your bond with Ciel-san was not deep enough.
I have to ask you to resubmit.
Please go back a long time, and make good friends with Ciel-san.
There are a lot of places you can do this, but the most important one is what happens on the sixth night.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
遠野くんは、もしかしてシエルさんとアルクェイドの天秤で、あのば○女を選びませんでしたか？
　その結果がこれです。
　これにこりたら六日目の夜に戻って、もう一度どちらを選ぶのか考えてみてくださいね。
　………………ね！
lines.label: s523
lines.maoEnglish:
Tohno, when you weighed Ciel against Arcueid, did you perhaps choose that idi○t woman?
This is the result. Let it be a lesson: return to the night of day six and think very carefully about whom you choose.
…All right?
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
Tohno-kun, when it came time to choose between Ciel-san or Arcueid, did you choose that idio**c woman?
This is the result.
If you have learned your lesson, please go back to the night of day six and think again about who you should choose.
……………… Okay!?
